APPROVE

The mixed-type branch always returns a nonzero value, so `if (c != 0) return c;` reproduces the original early return exactly. The int and string comparisons are unchanged, so behaviour is preserved. Extracting the pattern-matching chain into `CompareSegment` removes its branches from `Compare`, which should bring it under 15, and the new private static method introduces no obvious warnings. I haven't built it or run the analyzer.
